questions.question: In the wilderness, a man was caught gathering wood on the Sabbath. What did the LORD tell Moses to do to him?

answers.text: Make him bring a sin offering
Make him pay back the wood he took

questions.question: In the wilderness, what did God tell the Israelites to make for the corners of their garments?
God told the Israelites to put tassels on their garments. When they looked at the tassels, what were they to remember?

answers.text: All of the places they camped

questions.question: When God told Moses about the tassels, He said He was the LORD who brought Israel out of which land?
